class Solution:
    def countNonDecreasingSubarrays(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        n=len(nums)
        # next strictly greater element
        nge=[n]*n
        st=[]
        for i in range(n-1,-1,-1):
            while st and nums[st[-1]] <= nums[i]:
                st.pop()
            if st: nge[i]=st[-1]
            st.append(i)
        levels=n.bit_length()
        up=[array('I', nge)]
        sums=[array('q',(nums[i]*(nge[i]-i) for i in range(n)))]
        for _ in range(1,levels):
            pu,ps=up[-1],sums[-1]
            cu=array('I',[0])*n
            cs=array('q',[0])*n
            for i in range(n):
                mid=pu[i]
                cu[i]=pu[mid] if mid<n else n
                cs[i]=ps[i]+(ps[mid] if mid<n else 0)
            up.append(cu); sums.append(cs)
        pref=[0]*(n+1)
        for i,x in enumerate(nums): pref[i+1]=pref[i]+x
        def cost(l,r):
            cur=l; total=0
            for j in range(levels-1,-1,-1):
                nxt=up[j][cur]
                if nxt<=r:
                    total+=sums[j][cur]
                    cur=nxt
            total+=(r-cur+1)*nums[cur]
            return total-(pref[r+1]-pref[l])
        ans=0
        for r in range(n):
            lo,hi=0,r+1
            while lo<hi:
                mid=(lo+hi)//2
                if cost(mid,r)<=k: hi=mid
                else: lo=mid+1
            ans+=r-lo+1
        return ans
